I really love this micellar water. The scent is a nice soft lavender. I use this as the first step in my cleansing routine, to remove makeup (especially eye makeup, comes right off), or just to refresh and add moisture to my skin. Try it!

reviews.x: Much smaller than I expected. That's why it's cheaper than Bioderma.  The scent of lavender is very strong.  It works pretty well and does its job.  But I think I like Bioderma better because I felt it works better and lasts longer.

reviews.x: Love it. Takes my face makeup off very well and my dermatologist recommend it. However, I would not recommend for heavy eye makeup users

reviews.x: I absolutely love this cleansing water.  I have never tried cleansing water before, but I was curious if it was different than a cleansing lotion.  I use an acne lotion, but if I switch lotions my acne returns.  That lotion, however, does a horrible job removing my make-up, especially my eye make-up.  So I put this cleansing water on a cotton pad, and it took very little to quickly and easily remove my eye make-up.  I now use it every night and consider now a permanent part of my night-time beau

I have used a more expensive brand in the past and being a 1 income family was hoping to find a less expensive way to keep using the product. This is not it. It takes twice as much to remove my day to day make up (which is minimal) and you really have to scrub to remove mascara. I gave it 1 star because it does smell good. As I said I am on a limited budget so I will have to finish using it before I can try a different brand but I hope this can help someone else from making the same mistake.

I used this and it made my face tingle and then it got bright red. I tried washing my face with water to rinse it off didn't work my face was red and hot for a few hours. I decided to go to urgent care to have it checked out and they told me to take benadryl because I was having an allergic reaction to one of the ingredients. So needless to say I will be throwing this product away. I'm disappointed.

I have never used one of these cleansing waters before so I guess I expected it to be more like a water. Well it does contain  alcohol and witch hazel so  I found  that it left a slight burning sensation on my skin. Great for mistakes or cleansing on the  go,  but I think Ill stick to my regular washing for my daily regimen. It has a nice lavendar scent and you really dont need tt use much

reviews.t: Great addition to my daily cleansing routine.  Love it!!
reviews.x: This is a great product. I do not use every day and I just don't feel comfortable not rinsing after I use the product. Only because I have very sensitive skin. I'm sure it would not matter but its an old habit that everything I use I make sure I rinse with COLD water. Great smell I love everything lavender.  Thank you for creating a great face item that I can use.

It's so nice to be able to use a natural product to remove makeup. If you're like me, you wear makeup almost daily. So knowing that I'm using a pure product on my face is a good feeling. Smells great too! Very affordable. Even at Walmart makeup removers can be kind of expensive. This bottle is quite large, giving you more product for your money.

reviews.t: Great product for very sensitive skin
reviews.x: This stuff is just cool!  I can wash my face, remove my makeup all with just a swipe of a cotton ball.  Not only that but I have very sensitive skin and this cleansing water doesn't cause me to break out or have red splotches.  It also smells faintly of lavender which is very very soothing.  I love this product and will continue to use it.

reviews.t: I received this expecting this to really take off my ...
reviews.x: I received this expecting this to really take off my eye make-up.  You have to scrub hard to get make-up off especially around the eyes; I really had to use quite a big then I had to wash my face with soap to get the rest of the make-up off.  I don't know if I would purchase again; I guess I have to try it again to see if it does work.

Love it. Reordering now. Previously used the Caudalie micellar water and this works just as well with the bonus of the lovely lavender scent. I do have sensitive skin but have not had any problem with this even around my eyes. Takes all makeup off including mascara. I don't use waterproof mascara so I can't say if it will work there.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it effective at removing makeup, including face makeup and matte lipstick.
Several reviewers report eye irritation or burning, especially when used around the eyes.
Some reviewers with sensitive or acne-prone skin experienced redness, burning, or breakouts.
The lavender scent is noted by several reviewers, with some finding it strong and others pleasant.
A few reviewers mention the bottle is smaller than expected.
